name: neorgon-forge
description: Eighteen skills for finding your way into hard work, taking it on, then explaining it, arranged by where in the work you are rather than by topic. before/: forge routes over the whole set, wayfind maps an unfamiliar codebase, untangle works a problem whose shape is not known yet, grill argues with a plan a whole round of questions at a time, atlas extracts a dependency model and generates MkDocs pages and Mermaid diagrams from it. during/: task scopes and delegates while keeping a brief on disk, wizard generates a bash walkthrough for the steps only a human can take, handoff compacts a session for the next agent, repitch re-explains an answer that did not land, secret-safe-reporting keeps pipelines from leaking what they read. after/: debrief builds the deck, writeup builds the post, deckcraft repairs a deck whose headings name topics instead of making claims. craft/: penname drafts in the author's voice in English or Spanish, voicecheck audits copy that exists, groundwork dates what a service really requires before a tutorial promises it, quizmaster turns source material into a validated exam, mascot-forge generates and rigs a character. task, debrief and writeup share one brief written during the work, so the account of it is a record rather than a recollection.
